verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime adult-novel book-publication span, from Go Tell It on the Mountain to Just Above My Head, used as a publishing proxy rather than a claim of uninterrupted writing. Markers use first English-language book years, not composition, magazine excerpts, translations, reissues or adaptations. Go Tell It on the Mountain took roughly ten years to write before its 1953 publication. The six markers cover his adult novels; the 1965 Going to Meet the Man is a short-story collection, not a novel, and is excluded. Essays, plays, poetry and the illustrated children's book Little Man, Little Man are outside this scope. The 1979 endpoint therefore does not mark the end of Baldwin's literary activity, and posthumous collections do not extend the bar.
